title: Source-bound fixed irrigation date matching and event-index transition

source.equation: A fixed event matches iff abs(irdate(nirri)-t1900) < 1e-3 day; only a matched event assigns its application, advances nirri, and marks irrigevent=1.

scope: existing typed fixed-event interval evaluator at the exact B1.11 strict date tolerance
100000 deterministic date-offset comparisons around the inclusive/exclusive boundary
event application and next-event index advance iff source date match succeeds
non_goals: calendar ingestion/order validation, simulation-date conversion or crop-window scheduling
rate-adaptation, state owner, accepted mass, restart, solute or production admission
pass_conditions: match behavior follows abs(date-time)<1e-3 and not <=
a matched event applies once and advances the candidate index; misses preserve it
100000 deterministic source comparisons pass at O0/O2 with transcript identity
